# GoKubeDownscaler

GoKubeDownscaler is a Kubernetes controller that automatically scales workloads down on schedules to reduce cloud costs.

Use these docs in this order:
- `docs` for concepts and reference material.
- `guides` for step-by-step usage.
- `contributing` for local development and repository maintenance.

## Start here
- [Documentation home](https://kube-downscaler.io/docs) — introduction, architecture, and the main docs entry point.
- [Guides home](https://kube-downscaler.io/guides) — installation and common usage patterns.
- [Contributing home](https://kube-downscaler.io/contributing) — developer and maintainer workflows.

## Core documentation
- [Introduction](https://kube-downscaler.io/docs) — what the project does, how it works, what's the benefit, and when to use it.
- [Components](https://kube-downscaler.io/docs/components) — overview of the Downscaler and Webhook components.
- [Downscaler Concepts](https://kube-downscaler.io/docs/downscaler) — scaling scopes, supported workload types, configurations, types,
  and metrics.
- [Helm Chart Documentation](https://kube-downscaler.io/docs/helm-chart-documentation) — chart components, permissions, and values.
- [FAQ](https://kube-downscaler.io/docs/faq) — common questions and answers.

## Practical guides
- [Getting Started](https://kube-downscaler.io/guides) — entry point for installation and common patterns.
- [Installation](https://kube-downscaler.io/guides/installation) — install with Helm or manifests.
- [Basic Night Time Saving](https://kube-downscaler.io/guides/basic-night-time-saving) — schedule off-hours scale-down pattern.
- [Scaling Down for Holidays](https://kube-downscaler.io/guides/scaling-down-for-holidays) — holiday and long-weekend downtime pattern.
- [On Demand Startup](https://kube-downscaler.io/guides/on-demand-startup) — keep workloads down until they are needed pattern.
- [Migrating from Py-Kube-Downscaler](https://kube-downscaler.io/guides/migrating) — migration notes and breaking changes.
- [Advanced Guides](https://kube-downscaler.io/guides/advanced-guides) - advanced guides like concurrency and dns aware scaling.

## Contributing and development
- [Developing](https://kube-downscaler.io/contributing) — set up the repository locally.
- [Downscaler development](https://kube-downscaler.io/contributing/downscaler) — local development and testing for the project.
- [Website development](https://kube-downscaler.io/contributing/website) — how the Docusaurus site is structured and built.
- [Helm chart development](https://kube-downscaler.io/contributing/helm-chart) — chart authoring, testing, and versioning.
- [Maintaining the repository](https://kube-downscaler.io/contributing/maintaining-the-repository) — release process and maintainer tasks.
- [GitHub Workflows](https://kube-downscaler.io/contributing/github-workflows) — CI, release, and deployment automation.
- [Docker Image](https://kube-downscaler.io/contributing/docker-image) — cosign image verification and release details.
